==Notes==
* This chant is very useful to trigger [[Echo (skill type)|Echo]] finales and renew refrains, because it is one of the non-[[adrenaline]] chants that have the shortest activation and recharge times.
* This is particularly true for heroes since the [[AI]] will be using it on recharge, removing the need to re-activate skills such as [[Aggressive Refrain]].
{{bug|In the case of an attack skill that hits several foes, such as [[Whirlwind Attack]], only one will be inflicted with burning, and not necessarily the one targeted by the attack.}}
